profile.ipo_status: Csquare filed for and was pursuing a US IPO seeking approximately $1.35 billion, per Bloomberg and trade press reporting dated June-July 2026. This entry does not confirm whether the IPO priced or completed, only that it was filed and pursued as of that date.
profile.research_note: This registry holds three separate operator rows for what appears to be the same underlying company under three successive brand names: Cyxtera (uid 44a770f3), Centersquare (uid fe5f655b), and Csquare (this row, uid d01580f9, the current live brand). Evidence: centersquaredc.com 302-redirects to csquare.com, and csquare.com's own page content references both 'Centersquare' and 'Evoque' in internal file paths and portal URLs. Per the no-delete rule, all three rows are kept and cross-linked via duplicate_of rather than merged. Facility-level reconciliation (whether individual twoai_dc_facilities rows tagged with each historical operator name should be re-attributed) is deferred to the facility-research phase of this assignment, not done here.
profile.corporate_lineage: Evoque Data Center Solutions formed by Brookfield in 2019 from AT&T's divested data center assets. Cyxtera Technologies (originally spun out of CenturyLink infrastructure assets in 2017) filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy in June 2023, and Brookfield acquired Cyxtera's assets for $775 million in a deal completed January 2024. Brookfield combined Cyxtera and Evoque under a new 'Centersquare' brand announced April 2, 2024. The company currently operates under the 'Csquare' brand (current as of this research date).
profile.portfolio_as_of_2024_brand_launch: 320 MW across more than 50 data center locations, with 100 MW of near-term under-roof expansion, per Data Center Dynamics reporting at the April 2024 Centersquare brand launch
profile.portfolio_current_per_operator_site: 80 colocation data centers across 30 markets in North America and Europe, per the current Csquare site

reading:
Csquare is the current brand name, as of this research date, for a Brookfield Infrastructure-owned colocation platform built from two predecessor companies. Evoque Data Center Solutions was formed by Brookfield in 2019 from AT&T's divested data center assets. Cyxtera Technologies, spun out of CenturyLink infrastructure in 2017, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in June 2023, and Brookfield acquired its assets for $775 million in a deal completed January 2024. Brookfield combined Cyxtera and Evoque under a new Centersquare brand announced in April 2024, and the combined company has since rebranded again to Csquare, headquartered at 3100 Olympus Boulevard, Suite 510, Coppell, Texas.

This registry carries three separate operator rows tracing this same corporate lineage, Cyxtera, Centersquare, and Csquare, reflecting three successive name snapshots rather than three distinct companies. Rather than deleting or merging these rows, each is kept intact and cross-linked to this one as duplicate_of, following this assignment's rule against deleting registry data. Reconciling which individual facilities belong to which name-era is left to this project's facility-level research phase.

At its April 2024 brand launch, the combined Cyxtera-Evoque platform was reported at 320 megawatts across more than 50 data center locations, with 100 megawatts of near-term expansion under roof. The company's current site describes a larger footprint, 80 colocation data centers across 30 North American and European markets. In mid-2026, Bloomberg and trade press reported Csquare had filed for a US initial public offering seeking approximately $1.35 billion, though this entry cannot confirm whether that offering has priced or completed.

sources.title: Data Center Dynamics, Brookfield combines Cyxtera and Evoque under new Centersquare brand
